portalhub_goes_nowhere: Goes to a portal that no longer exists.
portalhub_not_linked_hint: (Without a choice, a portal still joins another with the same name.)
portalhub_host_silent: The host's game is not answering. PortalHub has to be installed on the host too.
portalhub_nothing_changed: Nothing changed. PortalHub has to be installed on the host's game too.
portalhub_link_back_hint: the other portal then comes here
portalhub_note: Star a portal to keep it at the top. "{0}" means linking back would replace that portal's current link.
portalhub_build_second: Build a second portal and it will show up here.
portalhub_msg_warded: That portal is in someone else's protected area
portalhub_msg_one_way: Linked one way only: the other portal is in someone else's protected area, so it was left as it is
